Hello all,

As part of my research into some Erdos problems, I have formalized the following modules in Lean, mostly using LLMs. I'm releasing them under the Apache 2.0 license in case they are of use to anyone.

  • Balog–Szemerédi–Gowers (Balog–Szemerédi 1994; Gowers 1998)
  • 2D two-point isometry classification (Mazur–Ulam 1932)
  • Dumitrescu's isosceles-triangle counting bound (Dumitrescu)
  • Near Enemy Theorem for bisector energy (possibly original result of this project; the bisector-energy notion it minimizes is from Lund–Sheffer–de Zeeuw)
  • Incidence-geometry generic lemmas from Elekes-Sharir
  • Pach-de Zeeuw real-algebraic-geometry core and combinatorial maps + planar edge bound
  • Elimination-order counting (Brass–Moser–Pach 2005)
  • Elekes–Sharir/Guth–Katz reduction (base)
  • and more! (see README for full list)

All top-level statements have been rewritten as Mathlib-only statements and are verified using the Comparator pattern.

https://github.com/mysticflounder/lean-formalizations
